text_block_list.text:
I hear some excited voices coming from
the
academy garden, so I go to check it
out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Basically, we have amaryllises over there!
And
then gladioluses, dahlias, and the
cherry on
top—hibiscuses!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: So they're all red and ostentatious?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Sí! Passion, fire, beauty! Perfect for a

summer-themed flower bed!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Well, it's clear that you've put a lot of
thought
into this... in your own way.
Although it sounds a
tad difficult to put
into practice.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Спешл Уик, any thoughts?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Well, um... When I think of summer, I
think of
sunflowers.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
There were sunflowers near my home
when I was
growing up, so personally, I'd
like to see some at
the academy too!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ah yes, sunflowers... A classic, reliable
option.
They may not have the novelty
one would want in
a new flower bed,
however.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: You're making a new flower bed?

text_block_list.text: Oh! It's Эйр Грув's trainer! Hello.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
That we are. We're just discussing the
best plan of
action.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер was meant to be in
charge, as she's
the head of the school
groundskeeping
committee, but
unfortunately—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Grass came down with a fever yesterday.
But she's
sooo responsible, she can't
even rest if her work
isn't done!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's why we decided to take it off her
hands!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the enthusiasm, but we have
to settle
the matter, and both of our
options have their
pros and cons.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to hear your input, if you don't
mind.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Plain yet achievable, or striking yet difficult? Which option would you favor?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, playing it safe, huh? Sounds about
right for
Эйр Грув's trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Well, sunflowers are emblematic of
summer, and
their versatility as
decorations is unmatched.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That said, I believe we can still include
enough
flashiness in this flower bed to
keep you satisfied.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: You mean we can use some red flowers?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: ...Yes, let's add some red.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Once the flower bed meeting reaches a
good
stopping point, the group decides
to take a
break. Suddenly, Эйр Грув
speaks up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Speaking of sunflowers, do either of you
know
the famous fable about them?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I think I do! My mom told me when I was
little!
Ummm, how's it go again?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Once upon a time, there was a girl who
fell in love
with the god of the sun. She
spent all her time
looking up and
following him across the sky, until
one
day, she transformed into a flower!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
That's what my mom told me when I
asked her
why sunflowers always follow
the sun!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're very well-informed, Special
Week.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa! Hold up! The girl
actually
became a flower?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's not a happy story! It's spooky!
And... a
little bit melancólica...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Many interpret it as a tragedy
about
heartbreak.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
However, a different emotion wells up in
me when
I hear the fable.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
The girl longed for something out of
reach. I think
such passion and bravery is
admirable.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
And I believe that the girl transformed...
because
she desired to do so.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
She longed to become a flower that
resembled
the summer sun she so
admired.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
The girl's resolve, these proud flowers—I
think
there's a certain beauty in them
both.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ohhh myyy—
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's with the strangely in-sync
response?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: A-Эйр Грув... I never knew you were...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: ...Such a romantic!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
F-forget everything I just said! All of
you!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I know I already made a suggestion, but
I really
like El's idea too!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I think a colorful, vibrant flower bed
would be
really popular with the other
students!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Oho... So you choose the path of thorns.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'd expect nothing less from a fellow
associate of
Tracen Academy.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Very well—I shall lead us to success.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
We will create an enchanting sea of
bright-red
flowers at all costs—no matter
how difficult it may
prove!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
First on the agenda is securing the
supplies.
Follow me, everyone!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Magnífico! What energy! What passion!
All hail
the Empress!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh man, it looks like we've really lit a
fire in her!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Oh! That reminds me of something.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I heard that when Эйр Грув runs, the
stronger
the opponent and tougher the
situation, the more
she smiles!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wh-what do you mean?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
The bigger they are, the harder they
fall... and
the sweeter the victoria! She
savors finding a
worthy opponent!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That particular smile of hers even has a
name...
They call it "The Empress's
Savage Smirk"!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wh-whaaat?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
O-oh no, Mom... Am I gonna finish this
thing
alive?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: A completely red flower bed... Hehehe...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
How exhilarating! I shall relish this
challenge!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
They seem like they're all having fun, so
I decide
to leave them to it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That's an order! No objections!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
